claim: The sample demo uses separate storage and never changes real packets.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open /demo; create a real-database marker; edit and reset demo; assert the marker is unchanged and the demo database is separate

claim: Packet contents are stored locally and are never uploaded automatically.
where: landing facts, dashboard, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; add a question and attachment; export ZIP; capture the entire flow and assert every request is same-origin

claim: Attachment bytes use device-local AES-256-GCM when Web Crypto is available.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; add known plaintext; inspect the demo IndexedDB record; assert the encrypted flag and absence of plaintext

claim: Exports an accountant ZIP, PDF index, and JSON backup that can be imported.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; inspect ZIP members, PDF signature, and JSON contents; leave demo and import the downloaded backup

claim: The missing-evidence list follows checklist changes.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; assert four seeded gaps; mark one ready; assert that row disappears and three remain

claim: Edits and ZIP export work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; wait for service-worker control; go offline; reload; edit checklist and download a ZIP

claim: One packet is free; a US$12 one-time license adds unlimited packets and duplication.
where: landing facts, purchase card, terms, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context on /demo; prove a second packet is gated; assert the Sociobot checkout URL and the US$12 product price source; mock a valid Sociobot verification; prove creation and duplication become available

claim: No account is needed to create and keep a packet in this browser.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet without any identity or sign-in step; reload and assert it remains

claim: Files up to 25 MB each can be added; larger files are rejected.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; add a 25 MiB file and assert it appears, then add a 25 MiB + 1 byte file and assert rejection

claim: Deadline Packet does not run analytics or advertising trackers.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context through root, demo, and privacy; assert all requests remain same-origin and no analytics or advertising script identifiers are present in the delivered app

claim: Packet data remains until you delete it or clear this site’s browser storage.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; create a packet, reload to prove retention, delete it with confirmation, reload and assert it is gone

claim: License verification never blocks the free experience.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context with a saved license and a deliberately stalled verification response; assert the free packet interface renders before verification resolves
